about:
Haus of Brands LLC is based in Glenview, Illinois. The company does not publicly state its founding year, ownership type, or founder names.

The firm offers end-to-end apparel manufacturing, including design management, fabric and trim sourcing, product development, quality control, and shipping logistics. Its production capabilities span knitting and weaving, dyeing and printing, fabric processing, and garment assembly, supported by more than 200 sampling machines and over 200 multi-head embroidery machines. Haus of Brands provides both cut-make-trim and full-package production, with a staff of approximately 25 employees.

The company serves apparel brands and retailers seeking full-package manufacturing solutions. Its service list emphasizes support for collection sampling, large-scale embroidery, and global logistics through an international group network.

Haus of Brands highlights eco-friendly manufacturing practices and a commitment to standards, though specific certifications are not listed. The company's tagline — “Look Better, Feel Better, Live Better!” — reflects its focus on delivering premium basics for the modern marketplace.
